title: Erdoğan: Economy Can Absorb Fund Shock; Interim Payments of Up to 1M Lira Planned
detail: Speaking in Şanlıurfa on Oct 3, Erdoğan said the Turkish economy has the capacity to overcome the fund crisis. SPK approved on Sept 30 interim payments of up to 1 million lira per eligible investor for funds run by Tera, Pusula, Atlas and Hedef; the Fund Coordination Board met Oct 2, and liquidation begins with money market funds. MHP's Bahçeli blamed weak oversight in how fund rules were executed.
